name: Upper Lynstone Caravan Park
accommodation: Caravans for hire (4 to 6 berth, including a pet caravan) plus camping and touring fields with electric hook-ups and eight hard standings
beachAccess: About three-quarters of a mile from Bude; the beaches are within walking distance
confirmedFeatures: Shop, heated shower block, family bathroom, accessible wet room, laundry, play area
overview: A family-run caravan, camping and touring park about three-quarters of a mile from Bude. Bude's beaches and sea pool are within walking distance. You can hire a caravan or pitch up in the camping and touring fields, and the park has a shop, heated showers, a laundry and a children's play area.
surfTripFit: Summerleaze and the other Bude beaches are walkable, and the camping keeps costs down.
